Source: github.com/nknorg/nkn-tuna-session v0.2.6
Upstream module checksum: h1:NsZIUHQdUU6fFIWBjl2i78mdZsaOjeeJ/G/EmxSEkSw=
License: Apache-2.0; original LICENSE and upstream README are retained.

Only client.go changes upstream production behavior. Its TCP listener takes its
NCP connection IDs from the authenticated initial handshake, validating unique,
canonical, in-range provider IDs and the arriving provider's membership. This
keeps positional NCP pairs aligned when the dialer cannot reach every provider.
The encrypted frame is verified before IDs are read or session state is changed.
Dialing, encryption, provider count, retry policy, UDP, and NCP are unchanged.

connection_ids_test.go is nLink's offline regression. From the sidecar directory:
  go test github.com/nknorg/nkn-tuna-session
  go test .
Both commands use the sidecar's existing dependency versions. Tests in the local
replacement module are not discovered by go test ./...; name that module as above.
The portable build uses the same go.mod replacement without build-script changes.

The module copy contains upstream package sources, protobuf source/generated Go,
module metadata, and its existing unit test. Upstream examples, paid/live tests,
and CI configuration are not included. Remove this local replacement only after
an upstream replacement passes the sparse-provider and authentication regressions.
